subject: Purchase token fix and split plan
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily@stratascale.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO request to finalize May invoice

Hi Irene —

We still need the formal PO number for May's services so we can submit the invoice to accounts payable. Our billing team attempted to match against the provisional token you provided (4521) but the spend ceiling came back as 0 and the invoice is blocked. Can you confirm the correct PO or let us know next steps?

I attached the vendor onboarding form in case anything is missing on our side. 

Thanks,
Emily Carter
Head of Finance Operations
StrataScale Systems
emily@stratascale.com
(attached: vendor_onboard_form_20260607.pdf)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily@stratascale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO request to finalize May invoice

Thanks for the ping, Emily — copying procurement and finance leads to resolve. Short summary: provisional token 4521 was issued during onboarding but was never mapped to an active spend cap in our ledger; that explains why your invoice is blocked.

Immediate asks:
- Can you attach the invoice PDF and the original onboarding form (good that you included it) so procurement can reconcile line items?
- We'll propose a split: one PO for the platform subscription (recurring) and one for the one-time professional services in May so spend caps align with their respective buckets. Jonas — can procurement generate two PO numbers and a small change order? Marissa — can you confirm whether we can temporarily raise the spend cap on 4521 for invoice clearance while we formalize the split?

I attached the provisional CSV we have showing the token mapping for your reference.

Irene Choi
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
(attached: provisional_po_4521.csv)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Carter <emily@stratascale.com>, Raj Patel <raj@stratascale.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Purchase token fix and split plan

Irene / Marissa — I reviewed the provisional mapping and ledger entries (JIRA: PROC-7821). Root cause: token 4521 was created by onboarding automation but the spend cap flag never propagated to the finance ledger due to a schema mismatch in the onboarding payload. Action plan: 

1) Immediate (same-day): issue PO-74218 for the platform subscription and PO-74219 for professional services. PO-74219 will cover the May invoice amount; PO-74218 will be the recurring purchase reference. Both POs will reference the original onboarding ID and include line-item splits.

2) Short-term (48 hours): temporarily raise the auth on token 4521 to allow supplier to submit the invoice for processing while POs are finalized. Finance needs written approval from Marissa.

3) Medium-term (1 week): patch the onboarding webhook schema to ensure spend_cap and spend_bucket fields are populated on token creation. I'll open a ticket with infra and link it to PROC-7821.

Marissa — I'm attaching a proposed split file with suggested line-item mapping (split_line_item_proposal.xlsx). If you approve the temporary auth increase, I'll create the two POs and send them to Emily & Raj for matching.

Jonas Weber
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
(attached: split_line_item_proposal.xlsx)

From: Raj Patel <raj@stratascale.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Carter <emily@stratascale.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Purchase token fix and split plan

Thanks for the quick triage, Jonas. We can proceed with the split approach — we'll accept two POs and re-submit the May invoice against PO-74219. Please send the PO numbers and the updated invoice instructions and we'll re-file immediately.

One note: since our billing cut for May closed on the 5th, can you confirm whether the temporary auth raises will allow same-cycle processing or whether it will slip to June payments? If it moves to June please indicate expected clearance date.

We'll wait for the PO numbers.

Best,
Raj Patel
Vendor Enablement Lead
StrataScale Systems
raj@stratascale.com
